messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: p99 latency > SLO (region=apac-southeast-1) — 5m burn detected. Alert ID PD-APAC-P99-1763001234 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Assigned to rotation: chris-oncall. Escalation timeout 5m. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-slo-burn
alex: ack. I'm on it. pulling charts now.
mira: I'm nearby, will check kv-cache hit rate and hotkey metrics.
samir: I'll check autoscaler and GPU pool health. any obvious customer reports?
emily: Support: a couple of customers reported slow responses and retry spikes, no major error rate yet. forwarding logs.
chris-oncall: thanks. quick triage — what are p95/p99 numbers? alex, can you paste the spike window?
alex: Grafana snapshot: p95 ~ 210ms (normal ~85ms), p99 peaked at 1.8s (SLO is 750ms). request rate up ~18% in apac. kv-cache evictions spike at 11:47.
mira: kv-cache item eviction rate: ``evictions/sec`` jumped from 0.2 -> 6.4 at 11:46. hotkey topkeys show a sudden burst from a single tenant.
ops-runner: autoscaler logs: scale-up delayed due to quota checks; new pods requested at 11:48, status Pending until 11:52 because of node provisioning.
samir: looks like coldstart/scale lag + hotkey knee -> tail latency. hitting model hotpath.
emily: customers seeing long tail for chat completions, some 504 retries. I'm flagging CS escalation for impacted accounts.
chris-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) throttle the hotkey source via gateway rate-limit rule, 2) enable fallback routing for low-priority traffic to smaller model variant (gpt-small-v1), 3) trigger emergency prewarm of dedicated pool. who can apply gateway throttle?
alex: I can add a temporary limit rule to api-gateway for that tenant. patch: ``curl -X POST https://api-gw/internal/rate-limits -d '{"client":"tenant-42","rps":10}'``. applying now.
mira: while that's in flight, I'll pin KV cache replication increase for apac edge: ``kubectl -n runtime patch deploy kv-cache --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":3}}'`` and watch evictions.
samir: I requested +2 GPU nodes in apac autoscale group. cloud console shows new nodes provisioning. also enabling faster scale-up policy for this pool.
ops-runner: prewarm CLI: ``redwoodctl pool prewarm --pool=dedicated-apac --count=4 --model=gpt-medium-v1`` — started. ETA ~90s.
emily: CS notified impacted customers with temporary workaround (lower concurrency). they acknowledged and asked for ETA updates.
chris-oncall: good. monitoring: add a short dashboard snapshot to PD incident. alex, paste query for tail latency every 30s.
alex: query: ``sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{le=\"1.0\",region=\"apac-southeast-1\"}[1m])) by (le)`` — pushed to incident. p99 trending down to 980ms after throttle + prewarm.
mira: kv-cache evictions dropping, replica increase applied, evictions/sec down to 0.8. hotkey traffic throttled at gateway.
samir: new nodes joined at 11:55, pool capacity +4 instances. autoscaler policy active. fallback routing still on for lower-tier requests.
chris-oncall: PD acknowledgement: chris-oncall -> incident owner. marking as "mitigated" pending stabilization. please keep updates in-thread every 5m.
emily: CS updated customers: "we've implemented temporary mitigations, we're seeing improvement. We'll confirm when p99 returns to < 750ms."
alex: p99 now 540ms at 11:58, p95 120ms. error 504s reduced to near-zero.
ops-runner: log tail shows no new node provisioning errors. kube events stable.
mira: still observing a small bump tied to a scheduled job from tenant-42 ~12:05 — suggest follow-up with account team to avoid sudden traffic spikes.
samir: leaving the faster scale policy for 10 more minutes, then revert to normal.
chris-oncall: warming down: disabling fallback routing at 12:10, removing gateway throttle at 12:12 after confirmation with mira. will handoff to oncall follow-up owner for postmortem.
emily: CS: ticket updated, customers acknowledged fix and asked for RCA.
alex: adding notes to incident: root cause = combination of tenant hotkey + delayed autoscaler provisioning. Mitigations applied: gateway throttle, kv-cache replica increase, emergency prewarm, autoscale policy tweak, fallback routing.
chris-oncall: thanks team. closing PD incident; leaving thread open for a short RCA action item list: - runbook gaps (node provisioning slow), - consider automated hotkey throttling for single-tenant spikes, - prewarm thresholds for apac pool. tagging ops and platform.
incident-bot: Incident closed (PD-APAC-P99-1763001234). Follow-up task created: TASK-9763 (owner: samir) — postmortem & runbook updates. :white_check_mark:
